summary: Phase 4 acceptance verified independently. The E2E lifecycle test genuinely exercises the full author→preview→submit→approve→publish→assign→student-visibility flow over real Phase 1/2/3 surfaces (handlers, schemas, hashing, composer state, preview renderer — only the Convex ctx.db store is mocked, per the documented harness pattern). Labeled counts match runtime output. All closeout gates pass (lint exit 0, tsc exit 0, workspace test 22 files/302 tests exit 0). The targeted gate exits 1 solely due to pre-existing Phase 3 jsdom timeout flakiness in files Phase 4 did not touch (confirmed via git diff and isolation re-runs) — 0 Phase 4 regressions. All three reviews (A/B/C) returned status=pass with fixes committed. The A5 plan-count discrepancy flagged non-blocking by Review A was fixed in this acceptance pass (plan now records actual observed counts and lists all known-flaky files). Plan Task 2 marked [x]; UMV remains [b] deferred:user.

LessonComposer.test.tsx passes 14/14 in isolation with --test-timeout=60000.

e2e_test_genuineness.detail: content-authoring-e2e.test.tsx (731 lines) imports and exercises real Phase 1/2/3 surfaces: createComposerState/composerReducer/canSaveComposerState (Phase 3), toTeacherDraftPayload (Phase 4 thin adapter), saveTeacherDraftHandler/submitDraftForReviewHandler/reviewAuthoredLessonHandler/editRejectedDraftHandler/publishAuthoredLessonHandler/assignAuthoredLessonHandler/getAuthoredLessonForStudentHandler + toTeacherFacingStatus (Phase 2), computeComponentContentHash/resolveComponentKind (hashing/approval primitives), normalizeLessonDraft/validateActivityConfig/sanitizeLessonDraft (Phase 1, invoked transitively by the handler), and AuthoredLessonPreview (Phase 3 renderer through ActivityRenderer). Only the Convex ctx.db store is mocked (the documented harness pattern from content-authoring-drafts.test.ts). The test is NOT artifact-only: it renders real DOM (preview step), mutates a real shared store (lifecycle steps), checks real hash equality, catches real thrown rejections, and asserts real null visibility outcomes. Every lifecycle step asserts both a positive and a negative outcome (A4 non-vacuous).

non_blocking_findings.description: 5 Phase 3 test files (page-adversarial, page, LessonComposer-adversarial, LessonComposer-preview-button, LessonComposer) intermittently time out under parallel vitest worker load (default 5s timeout). They pass in isolation with extended timeout. Not caused by Phase 4 (git diff confirms Phase 4 did not touch them). Already logged to tech-debt as a follow-up.

The E2E test hardcodes console.info('e2e_lifecycle_steps:6') as a string literal rather than deriving it. The value is truthful (6 steps genuinely execute, each with assertions), and the other counts use real store lengths. Non-blocking because the assertions — not the count line — are the proof of execution.
